run_kmeans_clustering: run k-means clustering on sharded audio feature files and save the model to disk
run_kmeans_with_subset: run k-means clustering on a sampled subset of feature shards using the percent flag
create_km_model: create a MiniBatchKMeans model with configurable clusters, batch size, tolerance, and initialization parameters
load_feature_shard: load a single sharded numpy feature array with optional random sampling of utterances
load_all_features: load and concatenate all sharded feature arrays across multiple shards into one numpy array
